name: Newrails Euro
oneLiner: EURW is Newrails' MiCA euro token, redeemable at par by verified holders through SEPA and backed by safeguarded euro reserves.
collateral: Euro-denominated cash and permitted liquid government money-market funds or similar investments in segregated safeguarding arrangements; the whitepaper sets a minimum 30% cash policy, not an observed portfolio allocation.
pegMechanism: All holders, including secondary-market holders, may redeem EURW for EUR 1 after identity, wallet and own-name SEPA-bank-account verification. The issuer charges no redemption fee and burns tokens before SEPA payment. Numerical minimum, capacity and settlement SLA are not disclosed; third-party bank and network charges may apply.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The MiCA whitepaper binds EURW to Newrails UAB, a fixed euro holder claim and safeguarded cash/cash-equivalent reserves, rather than a fund-share NAV; exact CoinGecko metadata and Monad symbol/decimals reads bind the authored deployment.
